title: Common CVE Quick Reference (Web Entry Points)
description: Public vulnerability checklist to try immediately when a fingerprint matches
detail:
Log4Shell: log4j 2.x → JNDI (try headers/parameters; prefer out-of-band detection first)
Shiro <1.2.4/1.4.2: rememberMe default key (kPH+bIxk5D2deZiIxcaaaA==) → deserialization
FastJSON <1.2.68: @type JNDI; 1.2.47 autotype bypass
WebLogic: T3/IIOP deserialization (e.g., CVE-2020-2883), /console unauthorized access (CVE-2020-14882)
Spring: Spring4Shell (JDK 9+), Actuator exposure → env/heapdump
ThinkPHP 5.0.x/5.1.x: ?s=index/think\app/invokefunction RCE
Struts2: S2-045/046/061 OGNL (Content-Type)
Jenkins/GitLab/Confluence: a series of unauthorized RCE issues (check by version)
When a fingerprint matches → check whether a vuln fact has already been tested in the graph → try a public PoC → record a vuln fact.
